requirement: Expand HWPX-to-DOCX editable shape/style transfer beyond the previously supported polygon subset.

supportedTransfer: HWPX inline rectangle to editable DOCX DrawingML preset rect
HWPX inline ellipse to editable DOCX DrawingML preset ellipse
HWPX inline straight line with canonical top-left to bottom-right endpoints to editable DOCX DrawingML preset line
implementation.mapping: HWPUNIT dimensions are converted to DOCX point extents and serialized EMU. BGR fill/stroke colors become RGB, solid stroke width is preserved, and supported rotation, flips, and alt description are retained. The native ellipse acceptance covers 90-degree rotation and horizontal flip. The line importer independently requires canonical endpoint geometry and refuses unsupported transforms.
implementation.preconditions: Only body-owned inline HWPX objects with treatAsChar=true, Square wrap, zero offsets, dimensions 200..14400 HWPUNIT, and no caption/textbox are accepted. The pinned RHWP portable extractor rejects rounded rectangles, unsupported fill/line styles, arrows, effects, and noncanonical line geometry. The DOCX engine independently validates shape kind, colors, dimensions, transforms, and alt text. A loaded DOCX body that fails source-model roundtrip is refused before mutation.
implementation.preservation: Source HWPX fixture bytes remain unchanged. The destination retains all 9 OPC part names; T009 changes only word/document.xml. Destination text and the preexisting DrawingML identity 1 remain unchanged. New editable shapes receive unique docPr IDs 2, 3, and 4. Undo/Redo, same-process document reopen, and a separate application process reopen preserve editability.
implementation.unsupportedCases: Rounded HWPX rectangle is rejected without changing revision, caret, render, or file bytes. A rotated HWPX line is rejected before DOCX mutation by the focused TypeScript regression. An unsafe non-roundtripping DOCX body rejects insertion atomically in Rust. Unsupported/freeform shapes, textboxes, captions, media, noncanonical line geometry, unsupported effects/styles, and unmodeled envelopes remain outside this mapping.

limitations: This is object-level structured transfer, not full-document format conversion.
Floating shapes, rounded rectangles, custom/freeform shapes, curves, textboxes, captions, media, unsupported effects/line styles, and noncanonical line geometry are rejected.
Wayland, Windows, macOS, and external Microsoft Word/Hancom reopen were NOT RUN.
Nix-independent runtime portability was NOT VERIFIED.
